maps.description: A compact first-contact battlefield built around three relay sites and two finite energy fields.
A larger contested network with a central energy reserve and multiple approach lanes.

scenarios.description: Own the Central Relay and your forward crossing while they remain connected to your Command Hub.
scenarios.player_win_message: Network held for 90 seconds. The Coalition relay line is secure.
scenarios.enemy_win_message: The Frontier held the network for 90 seconds. The Coalition line has fractured.
